title: vernoniastrum latifolium
intro: Vernoniastrum latifolium, commonly known as Broad-leaved Ironweed, is a plant species that belongs to the family Asteraceae. It is valued for its various health benefits, which include its ability to help manage fever, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties, thereby promoting overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Vernoniastrum latifolium involve its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine for treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
